Name: PaintedParrot's Blond Wizard Seasonal Portrait and Sprite
Author: PaintedParrot
Description:
[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]Why Is He Blond??[/size][/color]
[/b]Good question, idk.
I wanted to make a wizard portrait, but figured it would be more fun to give it a twist lol.

This is a content patcher mod that comes with my hand drawn portraits and sprites. [b]Now with 8 configurable seasonal outfits. [/b]
It comes with [b]7, 9, 12, and 32 expression compatibility[/b], as well as 3 different sprite sheets for compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], RomRas ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]SVE compatible[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]not[/url],) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RomRas Redux Revamped[/url]. All compatibility is set in the config, so it should be straight forward and easy.
It also includes a custom wizard teleportation sprite, and a custom CC bundle wizard image.

Here's an example of the portrait in high res, and the sprite in action:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1nD529S.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9PmXXcf.gif[/img]﻿

[b]Instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#f4f4f4]Install the required mod:[/color][color=#ffd966] [/color][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130][b][color=#e69138]Scale Up 2[/color][/b][/url][color=#cc0000] [/color][b][color=#ffff00](dependency changed)[/color][/b]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]If updating from an older mod version - Delete the previous Blond Wizard mod from your mods folder.﻿﻿[/color][/b]
[*]Download and unzip [CP] PaintedParrot's Blond Wizard into your mods folder.
[*]Set the config﻿ in my mod to match your needs. I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make this easier. If unsure, read compatibility section.
[*]Disable wizard in any seasonal mods if you use them to prevent it from overwriting the sprite. (Disable in config, or delete the wizard/magnus folders in the mod)
[/list]
[b][color=#ffff00][size=3]Notice: Mod version 2.0.0 switched dependencies to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130]Scale Up 2[/url]﻿. If you are using mod version 1.0.0 please use the old dependency, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits.
[/url]﻿[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Compatibility (in config):[/b]
[list]
[*]If using only SVE: Set portrait to 7, and sprite to SVE
[*]If using RomRas SVE Compatible: Set portrait to 12, and sprite to SVE. Set RomRas config to 12 portraits, and set to true for pink hair + sleep sprite availability.
[*]If using RomRas[b] [/b]NOT[b] [/b]SVE Compatible: Set portrait to 9, and sprite to RomRas.
[*]If using RRRR: Set portrait to 32, and sprite to RRRR
[*]If using only vanilla 2 expression wizard: Set portrait to any but 32, and sprite to any of the options as well.
[/list]
[b]Seasonal Configs:[/b]
[list]
[*]Each outfit is labeled by season and general colour theme, you can reference all possible outfits in the gifs above, or by checking the assets inside the mod. 
[*]You can disable or enable each outfit individually. Each outfit only works in the season it is labeled as. 
[*]If both outfits per season are enabled, they will rotate at random everyday. 
[*]If only one is enabled that will be the sole outfit all season. 
[*]If no outfit is enabled for that season, the outfit is whatever Default Backup Outfit is set to. 
[*]There can only be one Default Backup Outfit. 
[*]In theory if you want to set only one outfit for the entire year: you can disable all individual outfits, then select the one outfit you want in Default Backup Outfit.
[*][color=#ffd966]Seasonal outfits work only in SDV version 1.6, if you still use SDV version 1.5.6, please download mod version 1.0. [/color]If you really want to use a seasonal outfit in mod version 1.0: you can copy paste the one sprite + portrait sheet you want into version 1.0 then rename the new assets to what the old ones were.
[/list]
[b]Permissions:[/b]
[list]
[*]I don't allow any reposts of my mod, or the original artworks in the mod/mod description on any other mod sharing platforms, social media, etc.
[*]I don't allow anyone to directly edit my artwork/portrait mod and upload it. For example, someone editing my artwork to change hair colours, or redrawing parts of my portrait to create a feminine wizard variation is a no from me.
[*]I don't allow anyone to use my artwork to feed into AI.
[*]However, I do allow someone to redraw this wizard design for their own portrait mod. By this I mean creating completely original art work, in your own style. I'd actually be really curious to see how people draw him. Just credit me as the original designer/sprite creator please. 
[/list]If you're unsure, would like to use this wizard in some other project, or there's some edit you're just dying to see. Message me, I may be willing to add some edits myself, or give specific permissions if I'm comfortable with it.

If you enjoy my art, and would like to follow me (thank you). You can find my most active art accounts on [url=https://twitter.com/mackrelkart]twitter[/url]﻿ and[url=https://mackrelkart.tumblr.com/] tumblr.

[/url]Anyway, please enjoy and treat Mr. Blond Wizard well. My friends would joke that he's an amalgamation of Dazai from BSD, Howl from Howls Moving Castle, and Kaveh from Genshin. So if you're a fan of any of those... enjoy. :)

Update July 23 2024: Seasonals are done and released! Sorry for how long the seasonal update took. I started back in November with most raw assets finished in January. However the 1.6 appearance system and I became sworn enemies, so the coding took longer than expected. Throw in life shenanigans in there as well and that brings us to late July :) There are still some outfits I might add such as a Spirits Eve festival costume and wedding sprite variations in a future update, but I figured 8 outfits was enough work on my plate for now. Hope you enjoy!!!
